test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the given blanks, will complete the letter series.

N O P _ Q N O _ I Q N _ P H Q _ O P G _
solution:
Given :- N O P _ Q N O _ I Q N _ P H Q _ O P G _

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) P J N O Q → N O P **P** Q - N O **J** I Q - N **N** P H Q - **O** O P G **Q**

2) J P O N Q → N O P **J** Q - N O **P** I Q - N **O** P H Q - **N** O P G **Q**

 
• Here, ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6005bbe2ec8763c940944969d0814bda225fd4abc82c0c8944ee1254890bfa0.png] ' is repeated.

3) P J O N O → N O P **P** Q - N O **J** I Q - N **O** P H Q - **N** O P G **O**

4) J P Q N O → N O P **J** Q - N O **P** I Q - N **Q** P H Q - **N** O P G **O**

 
• Option (2) gives the pattern of :- N O P J Q - N O P I Q - N O P H Q - N O P G Q

Hence, the correct answer is **"J P O N Q".**
